name: Observer
description: Reads published definitions and adds community tags.

name: Contributor
description: Proposes definitions in their division and submits them for review.

name: Curator
description: Proposes, edits and deprecates definitions and manages tags in their division.

name: Reviewer
description: Approves, rejects or requests changes to submitted definitions in their division.

name: Admin
description: Group-wide governance: every permission in every division.
